questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: How many protons does a neutral carbon atom have?
questions.why: Carbon's atomic number is 6, so every carbon atom has 6 protons. A neutral atom also has 6 electrons.
questions.source: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, Chapter 2: Atoms, Molecules, and Ions (topic reference)

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: What is the approximate molar mass of H2O? (H ≈ 1 g/mol, O ≈ 16 g/mol)
questions.why: Water has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom: 2 × 1 + 16 ≈ 18 g/mol.
questions.source: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, Chapter 3: Composition of Substances and Solutions (topic reference)

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Isotopes of the same element differ in their number of:
questions.why: Isotopes have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
questions.source: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, Chapter 2: Atoms, Molecules, and Ions (topic reference)
